result:
Review complete — verdict: **approve** (tier1).

Key finding: the diff itself was truncated before showing `company-scope.ts` (the security-critical file), so I read it directly from the workspace rather than trusting the summary. `requireCompanyScope` genuinely verifies a membership row before letting a caller-supplied `companyId` become the VERIDIAN `organizationId` that selects the per-org API key — this is real, tested access control, not just claimed. No `.github/workflows/**` touches, no tier2-trigger paths (migrations/schema/auth/permission/payment/billing/rls/security), purely additive diff — consistent with the pre-assigned tier1 tag.

One real caveat flagged in `issues`: the category-distribution charts depend on a compliance-tracker backend endpoint that's committed but not yet pushed/deployed in that separate repo, so that one chart will 502 in production until it lands — disclosed honestly in PROGRESS.md and handled gracefully client-side (friendly error state, no crash), so it doesn't block this merge but is worth a tracked follow-up.
